title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile
summary: The briefing passes: the supplied notice supports the banner-only change, rollout window and lack of required admin action, and the listed controls are documented. Corrections should report the differing UI and PowerShell guidance, distinguish general licensing from unpublished banner-specific terms, and remove the unsupported timing detail for transcription.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 578867 concerns the Microsoft Teams automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile.
claims.quote: "id": 578867; "title": "Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile"; "products": ["Microsoft Teams"]

claims.claim: Teams on mobile will indicate that recording started automatically on call queue calls recorded by the organisation.
claims.quote: For call queue calls that are automatically recorded by the organization, Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped.
